cycles.title: Composition upper bounds and global assembly
cycles.result: Two shortcuts terminated. Fixed-gadget transparent composition cannot create superpolynomial rewrite distance, and local type inventory cannot determine global low-treewidth decision. Exact XOR-cycle local twins and a SAT-sound witness-cover upper bound were added as reusable artifacts.
cycles.claim_boundary: C017 does not prove an Extended-Frege lower bound, a locality lower bound, SAT circuit lower bounds, or P versus NP.
